name: @gears-frontx/template-design-guardrails
description: Adds a governed interface-generation and design-review contract to an existing FrontX project. The template contributes no runtime screen and owns no application code; it installs a short human-readable entry point, the @gears-frontx/design-verify workspace package (the runtime design-defect checker and its headless render runner, the static source check, the composed-markup axe suite, and the jsx-a11y lint fragment, with their dependencies), plus an AI-extension bundle with one design skill, frontx-design: a short map (SKILL.md) over references for theming, building, reviewing and verifying screens, the machine-readable rules (quality gates, design and layout contracts, component states, review rubric) and the state-inventory and handoff templates.
